name: lobby-cat-tablet
goal: T3, mockup chat-tablette v1 T2: on the lobby tablet, the host and a real client open the « Mon chat » tab by real clicks, wear « Petit sourire » and « Sans yeux », see « Tenue » last with « Sans tenue » first, and go back to « Rôles ». Each one's own avatar comes back from the server wearing the look; the other process's GameLog shows it applied on that seat (avatar.cosmetics.applied, read with logs.py --local). The captures lobby-cat-* are the evidence for the look. Dragging the cat is not played: the virtual input has no press-and-hold.
